about.title: ABOUT US
about.subtitle: ABOUT OUR SYSTEM
about.desc: Elderly Care Safety Monitoring System is designed to bridge the gap between elderly parents and their busy children. By integrating automated daily check-ins and multi-channel alerts, we guarantee peace of mind for you and safety for them.

how.title: How it's work
how.step1Desc: Every morning, the system generates and dispatches a personalized check-in web link directly to the elder's device via Telegram. This ensures a prompt and reliable start to the daily monitoring workflow.
how.step2Desc: The elder opens the notification and clicks a single, large "I'm Safe" button on the secure web page. No complex typing, username inputs, or tech skills are required.
how.step3Desc: Once clicked, the system instantly logs the safety confirmation, marks the parent as safe, and updates the caregiver's dashboard with real-time confirmation status.
how.step4Desc: If the safety confirmation is not clicked within the designated timeframe, the system automatically detects the response timeout and flags the safety warning.
how.step5Desc: Upon timeout, the system automatically dispatches priority emergency alert notifications via Telegram to children, caregivers, and local neighbors for immediate attention.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We have compiled responses for neighbors, bots, and check-in setups.
faq.q1: How does the daily check-in process work?
faq.a1: Every morning at 9:00 AM, the system sends an automated Telegram check-in message containing a unique link to the parent. The parent simply clicks 'I'm Okay' on the web link or replies directly to the Telegram bot with 'I am OK' to register their safety status.
faq.q2: What happens if my parent fails to respond?
faq.a2: If the parent does not click the confirmation link or reply by 10:00 AM, the system triggers the emergency escalation cron. It automatically alerts you (the child) and registered neighbors via Telegram so someone can check on them immediately.
faq.q3: Do my parents need to install a special app?
faq.a3: No app installation is required for the parent. They only need the Telegram app to receive the check-in notification. Clicking the link opens a simple, large-button web page in their mobile browser.
faq.q4: How do I register neighbors in the system?
faq.a4: You can add, edit, or delete neighbor contacts directly from the Child Dashboard under the 'Neighbors' tab. Just enter their name, phone number, and Telegram Chat ID so they can receive emergency notifications.
